rules.rule: The per-capita GNI figure KIS applies to every status with a GNI-based requirement, for applications filed from 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31, is the Bank of Korea's 2025 per-capita GNI of KRW 52,416,000. The one exception is E-7 (특정활동), which keeps the 2024 figure of KRW 49,950,000 until 2027-03.
rules.effect: Sets the KRW value of every 'N x GNI' threshold in F-2 and F-5
rules.source: HiKorea GNI notice as relayed by 경남이주민센터 consultation post https://www.gnscfw.org/1303; Bank of Korea '2025년 4/4분기 및 연간 국민소득(잠정)' 2026-03-10 https://www.bok.or.kr/portal/bbs/B0000501/view.do?nttId=10096874 (also reported at https://zdnet.co.kr/view/?no=20260310121053)
rules.quote: 2025년 1인당 국민총소득(GNI) 적용 기준 ○ (적용 GNI) 5,241.6만원 / 적용기간 '26. 4. 1. ~ '27. 3. 31. / 적용대상 GNI 기준을 요건으로 하는 모든 체류자격 / 특정활동(E-7) 자격에 한해 '24년 기준인 4,995만원 적용(~'27. 3.까지)

rules.rule: For applications filed from 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31 (in 2026 this means January to March), KIS applied the 2024 per-capita GNI of KRW 49,955,000. Before the Bank of Korea publishes in March, the GNI of the year before last is used; after that, the previous year's.
rules.effect: KRW value of the thresholds for applications filed in early 2026
rules.source: https://www.gnscfw.org/1303; EKW 동포세계신문 '영주자격 부여 1인당 국민총소득(GNI) 적용 기준 이해하기' https://www.ekw.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=20273
rules.quote: 4,995.5만원을 '25. 4. 1.부터 '26. 3. 31.까지 적용 / 신청일을 기준으로 발표일인 3월말 이전에는 전전년도의 일인당 국민총소득(GNI)을, 3월말 이후에는 전년도 일인당 국민총소득(GNI)을 심사기준으로 이용한다

rules.rule: The income examined is the applicant's taxed income for the calendar year before the year of application, the same year whatever the month of filing. If the tax office cannot yet issue that year's certificate on the application date, the year before is used.
rules.amount: An application at any date in 2026 is judged on income from 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31
rules.conditions: Every F-5 income test; the same rule is used for the F-2-99 and F-2-7 income items
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-1 change > incomeAmountCertificateFromTheTaxOfficeO note (transcribed from 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주(F-5) › 공통 서류, txt lines 18071-18147); EKW https://www.ekw.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=20273
rules.quote: 영주자격 신청일이 2026.1.1인 사람과 2026.12.31 인 사람 모두 2025.1.1~2025.12.31 까지의 소득을 산정함 ... 신청일 기준으로 세무당국에서 소득금액증명 등 납부한 세금 관련 공적 증명서류가 발급되지 않을 경우 적용함 (repo: 'Income = taxed income of the calendar year before the application (the year before that if the certificate is not yet issued)')

rules.rule: Definition of income. Only income that was reported and taxed in Korea counts, proved by the tax office's 소득금액증명 (one certificate per income earner counted) together with a certificate that all taxes are paid. Income that is tax-exempt under Income Tax Act art. 12 counts if supporting evidence is filed. Wage, business, financial and pension income are all accepted. If no official certificate can be issued on the application date, all three of the following are filed instead: the 근로소득원천징수영수증, bank records showing the salary was paid, and a pledge signed by the employer and the applicant. The decision can then be held until the official proof arrives, and PR is cancelled if the later records do not match.
rules.conditions: Every F-5 income route; the same three-document fallback appears for F-2-99
rules.effect: Earnings that were not taxed in Korea do not count. A new worker without a prior-year certificate uses the three-document fallback. There is no annualising of a partial year: the calendar-year total on the certificate (all employers combined) is what is compared
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml docs incomeAmountCertificateFromTheTaxOfficeO, supportingEvidenceForTaxExemptIncome, officialProofThatTaxesAreFullyPaidTaxPay; F-5-6 and F-2-99 change lists (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주 › 공통 서류; › 36. 외국국적동포 › 5.; › 30. 거주 › 9.)
rules.quote: 총수익과 납부한 소득세 등이 기재된 '소득금액증명'(세무서 발급) 등 납부한 세금 관련 공적 증명 서류 / 「소득세법」제12조(비과세소득)에 따라 소득세를 납부하지 않아도 되는 소득일 경우 / 영주자격 변경 신청일 당시 소득금액증명 등 공적 서류 발급이 불가능할 경우 (근로소득원천징수영수증 + 입금 내역 + 각서)

rules.rule: Whose income counts. By statute the livelihood test may be met with the income or assets of the applicant or of family 'sharing a livelihood' (생계를 같이하는 가족). In practice these are the spouse (not a de facto spouse), minor children and parents (not the spouse's parents) who lived at the same registered address as the applicant throughout the income year. When family income is added, the applicant's own share must be at least 50% of the threshold, except when the applicant is raising a minor child or is the minor child.
rules.amount: Example for F-5-1 (2x GNI): the applicant needs at least KRW 52,416,000 of their own, and the household together at least KRW 104,832,000
rules.conditions: F-5 codes whose income test is household-based (F-5-1, F-5-2, F-5-4, F-5-6 and others). F-5-13 and F-5-16 are excluded, see the next rule
rules.effect: Family income can be added up to 50% of the threshold
rules.stacks: An own-share floor of 50%; waived for a parent raising a minor child
rules.source: 출입국관리법 제10조의3제2항제2호 (law.go.kr); KIS manual rules as relayed by https://k-labor.co.kr/main/klabor_04_view.html?pgubun=8&lang=ko&find=&chapter_idx=443&items_idx=6887 and https://www.visaskorea.com/f-5-영주권-생계유지-요건/ and https://yoonhjs.com/?kboard_content_redirect=427; data/visadocs.yaml F-5-6 case 'combined household income: own share >= 50%'
rules.quote: 본인 또는 생계를 같이하는 가족의 소득, 재산 등으로 생계를 유지할 능력이 있을 것 (법 제10조의3②2) / 신청인, 배우자, 미성년 자녀, 부모(배우자의 부모 제외) 중 소득산정 기간 동안 신청인과 계속 동거하며 생계를 같이하는 사람 ... 주소지(체류지)를 함께 한 경우 동거로 인정함을 원칙으로 함 / 신청인이 미성년자녀를 양육하는 경우와 미성년 자녀인 경우 제외

rules.rule: For points-based PR (F-5-16) and pensioner PR (F-5-13), only the applicant counts as an income earner: family income cannot be added.
rules.amount: F-5-16: own income of at least 2x GNI = KRW 104,832,000 (applications from 2026-04-01)
rules.source: KIS F-5 livelihood rule as relayed by https://k-labor.co.kr/main/klabor_04_view.html?pgubun=8&lang=ko&find=&chapter_idx=443&items_idx=6887 and https://www.visaskorea.com/f-5-영주권-생계유지-요건/
rules.quote: 점수제 영주자(F-5-16) 또는 연금 수혜자 영주자(F-5-13) 자격을 신청한 경우는 신청인만 소득주체로 인정

rules.rule: Assets instead of income. Income and assets cannot be added together. Assets must have been held for 6+ months and kept until the decision. Debts are subtracted using the credit report (신용정보조회서) of the applicant and the household. The asset route appears in the manual's document lists for F-5-1, F-5-4, F-5-9, F-5-15, F-5-16, F-5-18, F-5-26, F-5-28, F-5-29 and F-5-S2. It does not appear for F-5-10 or F-5-13.
rules.amount: Threshold: a multiple of 통계청 가계금융복지조사 average household net assets. Leads say 1.5x for F-5-1, F-5-16 and F-5-26 (about KRW 707M, taking the 2025 survey average of about KRW 471.4M; unverified)
rules.conditions: An alternative to the income test, for the codes listed
rules.effect: The income test is replaced by a net-asset test
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-1 change > assetEvidenceRealEstateRegisterCopySaleC (onlyKo 자산보유 기준) with its note; the per-code presence of that document in the change lists (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주(F-5)); amount from https://www.haniseoul.com/ko/blogs/wealth-korea-f5-permanent-residency-gni-and-asset-requirements (lead)
rules.quote: 자산보유 기준 — 부동산등기부등본, 부동산 매매계약서, 임대차계약서, (예·적금)잔액증명서 등 (repo note: 'Assets must have been held 6+ months ... Income and assets cannot be added together.')

rules.rule: General PR (F-5-1): household income of at least 2x the previous year's per-capita GNI, with the applicant's own share at least 50%, or the asset route. KIIP level 5 or a comprehensive-test score of 60+ is also required.
rules.amount: 2x GNI = KRW 104,832,000 (applications 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31); KRW 99,910,000 for applications in January to March 2026
rules.conditions: 5+ years on D-7 to E-7 or F-2
rules.stacks: No income reduction for F-5-1 was found in any primary source
rules.source: https://www.ekw.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=20273; https://yoonhjs.com/?kboard_content_redirect=427; data/visadocs.yaml F-5-1 change list
rules.quote: 일반 영주(F-5-1) 등은 소득요건으로 전년도 1인당 GNI 2배 이상이 되어야 한다

rules.rule: NOT CONFIRMED. One blog (haniseoul) claims F-5-1 income drops to 70% of GNI with KIIP 5 plus a Korean degree, and to 80% with 100 hours of volunteering. No official text, nor any other source, applies these to F-5-1. They match the F-5-6 (ethnic-Korean) relaxations word for word, and the blog appears to have mis-assigned them. Do not model them for F-5-1.
rules.source: https://www.haniseoul.com/ko/blogs/south-korea-f5-permanent-resident-visa (lead, contradicted by every other source found)
rules.quote: (blog claim only, not quoted from an official source)

rules.rule: Overseas-Korean PR (F-4 held for 2+ years -> F-5-6), income route: household income of at least 1x the previous year's GNI, with the applicant's own share at least 50%. KIIP is not required.
rules.stacks: The reductions in the next three rules lower this base
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-6 change (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 36. 외국국적동포 › 5. 외국국적동포 영주자격(F-5) 부여 세부절차); MOJ press release 2026-02-11 https://www.korea.kr/briefing/pressReleaseView.do?newsId=156744291
rules.quote: 전년도 1인당 국민총소득(GNI) 이상을 충족하여야 함 / case: Income >= 1x GNI (combined household income: own share >= 50%)

rules.rule: Excellent volunteer (우수 자원봉사자): the F-5-6 income threshold falls to 80% of GNI. Requires a certificate from the Korea Central Volunteer Center (1365) showing 100+ hours spread over at least 6 months, counting at most 6 hours per day.
rules.stacks: Combined with 한국어 우수자 it gives 0.6x (see the stacking rule). It existed before 2026; the 2026-02-12 notice restates it
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-6 > volunteerRecordCertificateFromTheKoreaCe (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 36. › 5.); 대전중구자원봉사센터 https://djvc.or.kr/bbs/board.php?bo_table=04_01&wr_id=419; EKW https://www.ekw.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=20198
rules.quote: 일정 기간의 자원봉사 실적*이 있는 경우 GNI 80% 이상인 경우 인정 (* 한국중앙자원봉사센터 6개월 이상에 걸쳐 봉사시간 100시간 이상 확인 된 경우, 1일 봉사시간 최대 6시간까지 인정)

rules.rule: Excellent Korean speaker (한국어 우수자): from 2026-02-12, when the H-2 and F-4 statuses were merged into F-4, the F-5-6 income threshold falls to 70% of GNI. One of the following is required: KIIP level 5 completed, graduation from all of Korean elementary, middle and high school, or a Korean bachelor's degree or higher.
rules.conditions: F-5-6 applicants (ethnic Koreans on F-4). Effective 2026-02-12
rules.stacks: Combined with 우수 자원봉사자 it gives 0.6x
rules.source: MOJ press release '법무부, 동포 체류자격(F-4) 통합 시행' 2026-02-11 https://www.korea.kr/briefing/pressReleaseView.do?newsId=156744291 (PDF copy https://mybusan.kr/data/file/info/7ec6ab6845624f9834438f7ac32ed466_XbFvMTia_a4793161cbebb0565e4aa88945c26d20b53214b1.pdf); MOFA embassy notice https://de.mofa.go.kr/de-ko/brd/m_7200/view.do?seq=1344643; MOJ notice detail relayed by EKW https://www.ekw.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=20198
rules.quote: 한국어 우수자 및 우수 자원봉사자에 대해서는 영주(F-5) 자격 신청 시 소득 요건을 완화 / '한국어 우수자' 전년도 GNI의 70% 이상 충족 시 동포 영주자격(F-5) 소득요건 인정 (한국어 우수자: 사회통합프로그램 5단계 이수, 국내 초·중·고교를 모두 졸업한 자, 국내 학사 이상 학위 취득자)

rules.rule: Stacking. A person who is both a 한국어 우수자 and a 우수 자원봉사자 needs only 60% of GNI. This is the floor: no further reduction exists.
rules.stacks: Floor 0.6x GNI. The factors are not multiplied (0.7 x 0.8 would give 0.56); the rule names 60% explicitly
rules.source: MOJ notice relayed by EKW https://www.ekw.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=20198 and https://www.ekw.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=20200; kowork summary https://kowork.kr/blog/H2andF4integration
rules.quote: '한국어 우수자'가 '우수 자원봉사자'에도 해당할 경우 전년도 GNI의 60% 이상으로 소득요건 완화

rules.rule: Legacy rule from before 2026. Ethnic Koreans who spent 4+ years on H-2 as a domestic helper, caregiver, farm or fishing worker, or faithfully in the same manufacturing industry, had the F-5-6 income threshold lowered to 70% of GNI. It is unclear whether this survives the 2026-02-12 merger as a separate track.
rules.conditions: Former H-2 holder with 4+ years in the listed sectors
rules.source: EKW 'F-4 영주자격 신청 경제요건과 완화대상' https://www.ekw.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=20220 (lead)
rules.quote: 방문취업(H-2) 4년 이상 체류자 중에서 아래에 해당되는 자는 일인당 국민총소득(GNI) 70% 이상을 적용한다 ... 제조업 동일업종에서 4년 이상 성실 근로자

rules.rule: Alternatives to the F-5-6 income test, any one of which is enough: age 60+ with a pension from abroad of at least 1x GNI; property tax paid last year of KRW 500,000 or more, or own net assets at or above the average household net assets; annual trade with Korean companies of KRW 2bn or more; US$500,000+ invested in Korea; head of an officially recognised overseas-Korean organisation or company (now or in the past 3 years) recommended by the head of a Korean mission.
rules.amount: Pension 1x GNI = KRW 52,416,000/yr; property tax KRW 500,000; trade KRW 2bn; investment US$500k
rules.effect: The income test is replaced by the alternative
rules.stacks: Each is a separate route; they are not combined
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-6 change variants (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 36. 외국국적동포 › 5. › 나. 대상 및 신청서류 › 재외동포(F-4) 2년 이상 (F-5-6) 대상별 제출서류)
rules.quote: cases: 'Age 60+ with a pension from abroad >= 1x GNI'; 'Property tax paid last year >= KRW 500k, or own net assets >= average household net assets'; 'Annual trade with Korean companies >= KRW 2bn'; 'Invested USD 500k+ in Korea'; 'Head of an officially recognised Korean community organisation ... recommended by the head of a Korean mission'

rules.rule: Long-serving H-2 worker PR: 4+ years continuously at the same employer on H-2 in manufacturing, agriculture or livestock, or fishing (one lead adds caregivers and domestic helpers), plus EITHER a listed technical qualification OR own annual income of at least 70% of GNI. A change of workplace within 3 months to the same industry, for a reason such as unpaid wages or closure, still counts as continuous. Sources conflict on 70% versus 100% of GNI. No new H-2 visas are issued since 2026-02-12.
rules.amount: 0.7x GNI = KRW 36,691,200 (one older source says 1x = KRW 52,416,000)
rules.conditions: An H-2 holder in the listed sectors
rules.effect: Income can be replaced by a qualification certificate
rules.source: https://yoonhjs.com/korea_visa/korea_c38-f4-h5-h2/%EB%B0%A9%EB%AC%B8%EC%B7%A8%EC%97%85-h2-%EB%B9%84%EC%9E%90-f5-%EB%B9%84%EC%9E%90/ ; https://www.bangduty.com/status/yeongju-f-5/ ; KIS 비자 내비게이터 https://www.immigration.go.kr/bbs/immigration_eng/230/454086/download.do (leads)
rules.quote: 방문취업(H-2) 자격 동포가 제조업․농축산업․어업 분야에서 장기 근속 및 일정한 요건을 갖춘 경우 영주자격을 부여 / 연간 소득이 전년도 GNI의 70% 이상 (본인 소득만 인정)

rules.rule: Pensioner PR: age 60+, receiving a pension of at least 2x the previous year's GNI. Only the applicant's own pension counts. The asset route is not in this code's document list.
rules.source: https://k-labor.co.kr/main/klabor_04_view.html?pgubun=8&lang=ko&find=&chapter_idx=443&items_idx=6887 (lead); data/visadocs.yaml F-5-13 change (no 자산보유 기준 document)
rules.quote: 점수제 영주자와 연금 수혜자는 ... 신청인만 소득주체로 인정 ... 전년도 1인당 GNI 2배 이상

rules.rule: Points-based PR: 3+ years on F-2-7, own income of at least 2x GNI (or the asset route, per the manual's document list), and KIIP level 5. The current data says only 1x GNI is needed if you came through E-7-S2; no source for that was found.
rules.source: https://yoonhjs.com/?kboard_content_redirect=427 (lead); data/visadocs.yaml F-5-16 change (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주 › 11. 점수제 영주자〔F-5-16〕)
rules.quote: 점수제 영주자(F-5-16) ... 신청인만 소득주체로 인정 ... 전년도 1인당 GNI 2배 이상

rules.rule: Marriage-migrant PR (2+ years on F-6): household income (applicant or family sharing a livelihood) of at least 1x GNI, OR household assets at or above the median. Plus KIIP completion or a comprehensive-test score of 60+.
rules.amount: 1x GNI = KRW 52,416,000; asset route: 가계자산 중위수준 (amount not found)
rules.conditions: F-6 for 2+ years, on any of the three F-5-2 cases (marriage continuing, raising a child, marriage ended without the applicant's fault)
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-2 change (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주(F-5) › 2. 결혼이민자(F-5-2) › 2) 제출 서류)
rules.quote: 본인 또는 생계를 같이하는 가족의 소득금액증명 (일인당 국민총소득 이상의 소득금액) / 본인과 생계를 같이하는 가족 모두의 자산 증빙서류 (중위수준 이상의 가계 자산)

rules.rule: Reported relaxations for marriage migrants, unverified: 80% of the standard for some applicants; full income exemption for an applicant who is pregnant with the Korean spouse's child, is undergoing infertility treatment to have a child, is raising a minor child, or has lived with and supported the spouse's parents for 1+ year. The tiers reportedly also depend on the length of residence in Korea (under 5 years, 5 to 10, 10+).
rules.amount: 0.8x GNI = KRW 41,932,800; exemption = no income test
rules.conditions: F-5-2 applicants in the listed situations
rules.source: https://yoonhjs.com/f-type-visa-%EB%8F%99%EA%B1%B0%EA%B1%B0%EC%A3%BC%EB%8F%99%EB%B0%98%EC%98%81%EC%A3%BC%EA%B2%B0%ED%98%BC/?mod=document&uid=422 ; https://hanvisa.net/f6visa-f5visa-permanent-residence-korea-hanvisa/ (leads)
rules.quote: (lead summary) 원칙적 기준의 80%를 적용하는 완화 대상과 소득요건을 면제받는 대상 ... 국민인 배우자의 자녀를 임신한 경우, 자녀 출산을 위해 불임시술을 받은 경우, 미성년 자녀를 양육하는 경우, 배우자 부모를 1년 이상 부양하며 동거하는 경우

rules.rule: Spouse or minor child of a general PR holder (F-5-4): income of 1x GNI or the asset route (both are in the manual's document list), plus KIIP level 5.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-4 change (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주 › 3. 일반 영주자의 배우자 또는 미성년 자녀〔F-5-4〕)
rules.quote: 소득금액증명 ... / 자산보유 기준 (documents in the F-5-4 list)

rules.rule: Degree or licence holder PR (F-5-10): the applicant must be employed by a Korean company at a wage of at least the amount the Minister sets, which is 1x GNI. Only the applicant's own wage counts, and there is no asset route. KIIP is required.
rules.conditions: 3+ years of residence in Korea plus a qualifying degree or licence
rules.source: 출입국관리법 시행령 별표 1의3 제8호 (law.go.kr), quoted in visa-map-audit/findings.md; data/visadocs.yaml F-5-10 change (no 자산보유 기준 document)
rules.quote: 국내 체류기간이 3년 이상이고, 영주자격(F-5) 신청 시 국내기업에 고용되어 법무부장관이 정하는 금액 이상의 임금을 받는 사람

rules.rule: High-tech doctorate (F-5-9) and Korean doctorate (F-5-15): income of 1x GNI. The manual's document list for these codes also includes the asset route (자산보유 기준) and no basic-knowledge (KIIP) proof.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-9 and F-5-15 change (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주 › 6. 첨단분야 박사〔F-5-9〕 및 일반분야 박사〔F-5-15〕)
rules.quote: 자산보유 기준 (document present); 「소득세법」제12조(비과세소득)...

rules.rule: R&D staff of a foreign-invested company (F-5-26): income of at least 2x GNI OR net assets of at least 1.5x the previous year's average household net assets.
rules.amount: 2x GNI = KRW 104,832,000; or 1.5x the average net assets
rules.conditions: 3+ years on D-8 가목 as essential R&D staff, bachelor's degree
rules.source: visa-map-audit/findings.md (verifier-upheld finding citing https://yoonhjs.com/f-type-visa-%EB%8F%99%EA%B1%B0%EA%B1%B0%EC%A3%BC%EB%8F%99%EB%B0%98%EC%98%81%EC%A3%BC%EA%B2%B0%ED%98%BC/?mod=document&uid=406); data/visadocs.yaml F-5-26
rules.quote: 소득 : 전년도 1인당 국민총소득(GNI) 2배 이상 / 자산 : 전년도 평균 순자산 1.5배 이상

rules.rule: Family of a points-based or K-STAR PR holder (F-5-18, F-5-S2) and family of a special contributor (F-5-29): income of 1x GNI or the asset route, plus KIIP. Minors under 15, and minors 15+ in regular schooling, are exempt from basic knowledge.
rules.effect: An asset alternative exists; basic knowledge is waived for minors
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-18, F-5-S2, F-5-29 change lists (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주 › 11.; › 18.; › 41. K-STAR › Ⅳ.)
rules.quote: proofOfBasicKoreanAbility note: 'Exempt: minors under 15, and minors 15+ enrolled in regular education'; 자산보유 기준

rules.rule: Special-contributor PR (F-5-28): income of 1x GNI or the asset route (as the data says), plus KIIP. The manual lists no extra documents of its own for F-5-28; only the common list applies.
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-28 change (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주 › 공통 서류 (+ 18. 특별기여자〔F-5-28〕: 제출서류 없음))
rules.quote: 18. 특별기여자〔F-5-28〕: 제출서류 없음 (common list incl. 자산보유 기준)

rules.rule: K-STAR PR (F-5-S1) uses a points table (the data cites 90 of 200 points) instead of a fixed GNI multiple. Annual income is a scored item, proved by the 소득금액증명 (earned-income or global-income version). A listed-company (prospective) employee who cannot file the certificate may use their contract salary. There are bonus items for living or working outside the capital region (지방 거주·근무), for a recommendation, and for volunteering.
rules.amount: Points, not a GNI multiple; the bracket values were not found
rules.conditions: 3+ years on F-2-7S, or on F-2-7 as a K-STAR graduate
rules.effect: Regional residence or work, recommendation and volunteering add points, which partly offset lower income
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-S1 change (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 41. K-STAR 비자트랙 › Ⅲ. K-STAR 영주(F-5-S1) › 4. 제출서류 + 붙임 7)
rules.quote: 근로소득만 있는 경우 / 사업소득만 있는 경우 / 상장법인 취업(예정)자로서 소득금액증명 제출이 불가한 경우 / 지방 거주·근무 / 추천 / 봉사

rules.rule: Top-Tier resident (F-2-T): base criteria are a top-100 master's or doctorate, a long career, and income of at least 3x GNI, plus a ministry recommendation. Dropping EITHER the degree leg OR the career leg requires income of at least 4x GNI. A change of status in Korea is open to someone employed for 1+ year in an advanced field (on D-7 to E-7 or F-2) who meets every criterion except income and keeps income of at least 2x GNI, with a ministry recommendation.
rules.conditions: F-2-T, by visa or by change of status
rules.effect: 4x income relaxes one leg; 1 year in Korea relaxes income to 2x
rules.stacks: Only one leg can be dropped; never both
rules.source: 법무부고시 제2026-160호 and 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 39. 톱티어 비자 › Ⅰ › 2 톱티어 거주(F-2-T), as extracted in visa-map-audit/findings.md (earlier session)
rules.quote: 주재(D-7) ~ 특정활동(E-7) 또는 거주(F-2) 자격으로 1년 이상 첨단분야에 취업한 사람 중 소득요건을 제외한 최우수인재 자격 기준을 모두 충족한 사람으로서, 1인당 GNI 2배 이상 소득을 유지하고, 관계 중앙행정기관의 추천을 받은 자

rules.rule: Top-Tier PR (F-5-T): 3+ years on F-2-T in an advanced or science field, income kept at 3x GNI, and KIIP 3 or TOPIK 3.
rules.source: data/visamap.yaml F-5-T how; data/visadocs.yaml F-5-T change (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 39. › 톱티어 영주(F-5-T)) for KIIP/TOPIK 3
rules.quote: KIIP level 3+ or TOPIK level 3+ (visadocs note); income figure not independently re-verified

rules.rule: Family of a points-based resident: the spouse or minor child gets F-2-71 only if the F-2-7 (or F-2-7S) holder's annual income is at least the latest per-capita GNI. If it is lower, the family is given F-1 (방문동거) instead.
rules.conditions: Spouse or minor child of an F-2-7 or F-2-7S holder
rules.effect: Below 1x GNI the family gets F-1, not F-2-71
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-1 extend case (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 29. 방문동거(F-1) › 체류기간 연장허가 › 11. 점수제 우수인재(F-2-7)의 배우자 또는 미성년자녀)
rules.quote: Spouse or minor child of a points-based talent (F-2-7) whose annual income is below the latest per-capita GNI (manual section 29-11, F-1)

rules.rule: For the professional track, the 3-year residence requirement is waived for an applicant whose annual income is KRW 40M or more, counted only for people who file a 소득금액증명.
rules.amount: KRW 40,000,000 fixed (not GNI-linked in the sources found)
rules.conditions: D-5 to E-7 (and similar) holders applying for F-2-7
rules.source: https://easypolicy.co.kr/32 and other F-2-7 guides (leads); matches the current data note
rules.quote: 연간 소득금액이 4천만 원 이상인 자(소득금액증명 제출자에 한함)는 3년 체류기간 요건이 면제

rules.rule: Listed-company or promising-industry track: income of at least 1.5x GNI. Someone hired, or about to be hired, by a KOSPI- or KOSDAQ-listed company who cannot file a 소득금액증명 may use the salary in the employment contract instead.
rules.conditions: An F-2-7 applicant on the listed-company or promising-industry track (including D-2 and D-10 graduates)
rules.effect: Contract salary is accepted in place of last year's income
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-7 abroad note (사증발급 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.1 › 30. 거주(F-2) › 사증발급인정서 › 1) 상장 법인·유망산업분야 종사자); 1.5x from https://koreaworkexpert.com/f2-7-long-term-residency-visa-korea-2026-points-guide/ (lead)
rules.quote: Latest-year income certificate issued by the tax office within 2 years before applying. Only for people employed (or to be employed) by a KOSPI/KOSDAQ-listed company who cannot submit it, the salary in the employment contract is used instead.

rules.rule: The F-2-7 income item scores taxed income from the latest 소득금액증명 in fixed KRW brackets, not in GNI multiples: KRW 100M+ scores 60; KRW 30-40M scores 30; minimum wage to KRW 30M scores 10; no proof, unemployed or below minimum wage scores 0. The pass mark is 80, from 130 common points plus up to 40 bonus points. The bonus includes a ministry recommendation, KIIP 5, a top university, and domestic volunteering.
rules.effect: Income is a score, not a threshold
rules.stacks: Points add up; the 2026 table also has deductions
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-7 change note on the points table (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 30. 거주 › 5.); bracket values from https://insight-b2g.com/columns/f2-7-points-income-score (lead)
rules.quote: income — latest tax-office income certificate (no proof, unemployed or below minimum wage = 0 points) / 연간 소득 (소득금액증명원 기준) 1억 원 이상 60점 ... 3천만원 ~ 4천만원 미만 : 30점, 최저임금 ~ 3천만원 미만 : 10점

rules.rule: F-2-7 extension. A holder who is unemployed at extension, or whose income is at or below the minimum wage, signs a pledge. If the shortfall lasts 1 year or more, the extension can be refused: two 6-month extensions are given, and at the third failure the holder is changed to D-10.
rules.effect: Losing income downgrades the status toward D-10
rules.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-2-7 extend (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 30. 거주 › 체류기간 연장허가 › 3. 점수제에 의한 우수인재)
rules.quote: 체류기간연장 신청 시 실직 상태인 경우 또는 최저임금 이하의 소득을 제출하는 경우

rules.rule: Regional talent (F-2-R): with a local-government recommendation and a job in a depopulating area, the applicant needs EITHER a Korean associate degree (전문학사) or higher OR income of at least 70% of the previous year's GNI, plus the Korean-language requirement and a 5-year residence pledge. The 70% figure is from memory and leads; no source was read in this session.
rules.effect: Income is an alternative to the degree
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 37. 지역특화형비자 › Ⅱ (not read); leads https://koreaworkexpert.com/f2-r-regional-talent-residency-visa-korea-2026/
rules.quote: (not quoted; unverified)

rules.rule: A regional overseas Korean (F-4-R) who lives 4+ years in a depopulating area reportedly needs income of only 70% of GNI for PR. This matches the data's F-5-6R income figure, but no official text for the code 'F-5-6R' or its KIIP 5 requirement was found.
rules.conditions: F-4-R residence in a depopulating area for 4+ years
rules.stacks: Unknown whether it combines with the 2026 한국어 우수자 or volunteer reductions
rules.source: https://hanvisa.net/f-4-visa-f4%EB%B9%84%EC%9E%90-%ED%95%9C%EA%B5%AD%EC%9E%AC%EC%99%B8%EB%8F%99%ED%8F%AC%EB%B9%84%EC%9E%90-f4%EB%B9%84%EC%9E%90%EC%A4%80%EB%B9%84%EC%84%9C%EB%A5%98-f4%EB%B9%84%EC%9E%90%EC%97%B0%EC%9E%A5/ (lead)
rules.quote: 인구감소지역으로 이주한 동포가 4년 거주 시 소득 요건이 GNI의 70%로 완화 (lead summary)

rules.rule: Legal basis for every relaxation. The Minister of Justice may relax or waive the livelihood requirement (생계유지 능력) and the basic-knowledge requirement (기본소양) for persons named by Presidential Decree, and must publish the criteria as a 고시. The manual's reductions (for example the F-5-6 80/70/60%) rest on this. According to the Seoul Administrative Court in case 2022구단72871 (2024-07-12), the notice does not list refugees among the relaxation targets.
rules.effect: Only the groups listed in the notice or manual get reductions; others need a court challenge
rules.source: 출입국관리법 제10조의3제3항 (law.go.kr); 서울행정법원 2022구단72871 https://www.lawhome.or.kr/ko/precedent/document/19423/download
rules.quote: 이 경우 법무부장관은 그 완화 또는 면제의 기준을 정하여 고시한다

rules.rule: Refugee PR (F-5-27): refugees are not among the MOJ notice's relaxation groups, so the ordinary income test applies. In the 2024-07-12 judgment of case 2022구단72871 (a refusal to change status), the Seoul Administrative Court treated the mechanical application of the notice's income standard as relevant to an abuse of discretion. The exact standard for F-5-27 was not found.
rules.effect: No formal reduction; possible case-by-case relief through the courts
rules.source: https://www.lawhome.or.kr/ko/precedent/document/19423/download ; https://casenote.kr/%EC%84%9C%EC%9A%B8%ED%96%89%EC%A0%95%EB%B2%95%EC%9B%90/2022%EA%B5%AC%EB%8B%A872871
rules.quote: 출입국관리법 제10조의3 제2항 제2호에서 '본인 또는 생계를 같이하는 가족의 소득, 재산 등으로 생계를 유지할 능력이 있을 것'을 영주자격의 요건으로 정하는 자체를 배제할 수 없다

dataDiscrepancies.current: 2+ years on F-4 plus income of 1× GNI or another option (assets, trade, investment, pension at 60+); KIIP not required.
dataDiscrepancies.correct: 2+ years on F-4. Household income of at least 1× GNI (₩52.4M from April 2026), with your own share at least half. The threshold drops to 80% (₩41.9M) with 100+ hours of 1365-certified volunteering over 6+ months, to 70% (₩36.7M) for strong Korean (KIIP 5, Korean primary to high school, or a Korean bachelor's), and to 60% (₩31.4M) with both (since 2026-02-12). Alternatives: pension from abroad of 1× GNI at 60+, property tax of ₩500k+ or average net assets, ₩2bn of trade, or US$500k invested. KIIP not required.

dataDiscrepancies.correct: Unchanged, but add 'own pension only; no asset alternative'.
dataDiscrepancies.source: k-labor.co.kr lead; data/visadocs.yaml F-5-13 (no asset document)

dataDiscrepancies.correct: income of 1× GNI or assets (the manual lists the asset route for both codes); no KIIP requirement
dataDiscrepancies.source: data/visadocs.yaml F-5-9 and F-5-15 change lists (외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. › 6.)

dataDiscrepancies.correct: income of 1× GNI or assets; KIIP level 5
income of 1× GNI or assets (children under 15, or 15+ in school, are exempt from KIIP)
income of 2× GNI or net assets of 1.5× the average household

dataDiscrepancies.current: Spouse or minor child of an F-2-7 or F-2-7S holder who earns at least 1× GNI.
dataDiscrepancies.correct: Correct; add 'otherwise the family gets F-1 (방문동거)'.

dataDiscrepancies.correct: Income of 3× GNI (₩157.2M). 4× GNI (₩209.7M) lets you drop the degree OR the career leg, never both. An in-Korea change after 1+ year in an advanced field needs 2× GNI (₩104.8M) plus every other criterion and a ministry recommendation.

dataDiscrepancies.current: 4+ years on F-4-R in the region (2 years for existing residents); income of 70% of GNI; KIIP level 5.
dataDiscrepancies.correct: The 70% after 4 years in a depopulating area is supported by a lead. The code F-5-6R, the 2-year clause and KIIP 5 are unsourced (F-5-6 normally needs no KIIP). Verify before showing.

dataDiscrepancies.correct: State the figure in force: 1× GNI = ₩52,416,000 for applications 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31 (₩49,955,000 before). The test uses the calendar-year income before the year of application, taxed income on the 소득금액증명.

dataDiscrepancies.current: After 3+ years in this status (waived with income of ₩40M+); 80+ points.

openQuestions: Do the 2026-02-12 70% (한국어 우수자) and 60% (both) reductions apply only to F-5-6 (from F-4)? Or also to F-5-14, former H-2 holders now on F-4, F-4-R holders and other F-5 codes? And does 'effective 2026-02-12' mean the application date?
Does the 80% volunteering reduction apply to any non-ethnic-Korean F-5 code (F-5-1, F-5-2, F-5-4 ...)? A volunteer centre notice says only '영주(F-5)'; the manual extract ties it to F-5-6.

Exact asset thresholds per code: F-5-1, F-5-16 and F-5-26 at 1.5× the average household net assets? F-5-6 at 1× the average? F-5-2 at the median? Which 통계청 가계금융복지조사 year applies, and what are the 2026 KRW amounts? A lead gives an average of ₩471.4M (2025 survey) and 1.5× ≈ ₩707M.
F-5-14: is the income test 70% or 100% of GNI, does it include caregivers and domestic helpers, and is the route still open after the H-2/F-4 merger?
F-2-3: is there a sponsor income multiple ('1× GNI, 70% for up to 3 people' in the data)? Not found in the manual lists.
F-2-99 (guideline effective 2025-07-07): actual income and asset thresholds. The data says own income ₩40M+ and assets ₩20M+; not verified, and whether these are GNI-linked is unknown.
F-2-R: is the income alternative to a Korean associate degree 70% of GNI? Is the 2026 Korean requirement KIIP/TOPIK 3 or 4?
F-2-7: is the 3-year waiver still a fixed ₩40M in the 2026 manual? Is the listed-company/promising-industry track 1.5× GNI?
F-5-16: is there any official basis for '1× GNI if you came via E-7-S2'?
Does E-7's special GNI (₩49.95M until 2027-03) also apply to income tests for E-7 holders changing to F-2-7, F-2-T or F-5? Or do those use ₩52.416M?
KIS fixed ₩52,416,000 (BOK preliminary, March 2026); the BOK revised 2025 GNI to ₩52,570,000 on 2026-06-09. Confirm that KIS did not switch mid-period.

Gross versus taxable: for wage income, is the figure compared the 총급여액 shown on the 소득금액증명, or the 근로소득금액 after the earned-income deduction? For business income, revenue or 소득금액 (revenue minus expenses)? The manual wording '총수익과 납부한 소득세 등이 기재된 소득금액증명' suggests gross, unconfirmed.

Partial first year or job change: is there any annualisation for someone who started work mid-year (other than the listed-company contract-salary exception for F-2-7 and K-STAR)? None was found; the calendar-year total appears to be used.
F-5-2: the official list of relaxed (80%) and exempt groups and the residence-length tiers (5 and 10 years).
F-5-27 (refugees): the income standard actually applied, and how the 2022구단72871 judgment changed practice.
F-5-9 / F-5-15: is the income test the applicant's own wage (as for F-5-10) or household, and is the asset route really allowed? It is inferred only from the manual's document list.
Basic-knowledge (KIIP) waivers tied to income: one blog says high earners are exempt from KIIP for F-5. No primary source found.

Main conclusions:
1. The only well-attested stacking reduction catalogue is for F-5-6 (ethnic Korean on F-4 for 2+ years). Base is 1× GNI household income with own share ≥ 50%. Volunteer (100 h over 6+ months, 1365 certificate) gives 0.8×. 한국어 우수자 (KIIP 5, Korean primary to high school, or Korean bachelor's+) gives 0.7×, from 2026-02-12. Both give 0.6×, which is the floor; the factors are not multiplied. Plus non-income alternatives: pension at 60+ ≥ 1× GNI, property tax ≥ ₩500k or average net assets, ₩2bn trade, US$500k investment, community-leader recommendation. 'Up to 70%' in the brief most likely refers to this 70% level. The deepest confirmed cut is to 60% of GNI.
2. No income reduction exists for F-5-1 or F-5-16 in any official source found. The KIIP / degree / volunteering claims for F-5-1 trace to one blog that mis-assigned the F-5-6 rules.
3. 2026 amounts: 1× GNI = ₩52,416,000 for applications 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31 (₩49,955,000 before); E-7 keeps ₩49.95M until 2027-03. So 0.6× = ₩31,449,600, 0.7× = ₩36,691,200, 0.8× = ₩41,932,800, 1.5× = ₩78,624,000, 2× = ₩104,832,000, 3× = ₩157,248,000, 4× = ₩209,664,000.
4. Income definition: taxed Korean income of the calendar year before the application year, on the tax office's 소득금액증명, one per earner. Tax-exempt income under 소득세법 §12 counts with proof. If the certificate cannot yet be issued: withholding receipt + salary-deposit record + employer/applicant pledge, decision held, PR cancelled if records later differ. Household = spouse, minor children and parents (not in-laws) at the same address for the whole year, applicant's own ≥ 50% unless raising a minor child. F-5-13 and F-5-16 count the applicant only. Income and assets cannot be combined; assets must be held 6+ months, net of debts on the credit report.

For implementation: the engine has no income fact, so none of this can gate today. The rules need:
- an income fact, in KRW or as a GNI multiple band, plus own-versus-household;
- a volunteering fact (100 h / 6 months);
- the existing koreanEdu fact and a blocking KIIP level to detect 한국어 우수자;
- a per-code threshold function: base multiple × (F-5-6 only) one of {1, 0.8, 0.7, 0.6};
- a separate asset branch per code;
- and the KRW figure should be data, not hard-coded, because it changes every April.
